Jacobin.author: Jeff Fuller

Jacobin.title: Medieval Egypt Was No Stranger to Class War
Jacobin.summary: Egypt in the Middle Ages was steeply class stratified. When the rains failed, the rich dined on hoarded grain while the starving poor ate grass. Periodically, the masses would erupt in revolt — sometimes with petitions, other times with stones.
Jacobin.author: Nicholas Liu

Jacobin.title: Mike Wallace, Gotham’s Chronicler
Jacobin.summary: Historian Mike Wallace, author of the Gotham trilogy of New York City history and winner of the Pulitzer Prize, tried to capture everything about New York and the world through a droll, cheerful, humanistic Marxism.
Jacobin.author: Joel Feingold

Jacobin.title: Profits Are Soaring. Workers’ Share of Income Is Sinking.
Jacobin.summary: Working people’s share of national income has fallen to a record low, even as corporate profits soar to unthinkable new heights. The trend reflects decades of eroded worker power, and reversing it will take a revitalized labor movement.
Jacobin.author: Conor Lynch

Jacobin.title: Isabella Weber on How to Defeat the Far Right
Jacobin.summary: Key to a long-term solution to defeating the far right is an economic program that guarantees security to all, including the affordability of housing and other essential components of a dignified life, Isabella Weber tells Jacobin.
Jacobin.author: Isabella Weber, Bartolomeo Sala

Jacobin.title: The Green Party Will Regain Momentum if It Keeps Its Nerve
Jacobin.summary: Zack Polanski’s leadership of the Green Party is facing its biggest challenge to date. But the Greens can weather the storm if they stand their ground against deceitful attacks from Andy Burnham’s Labour government over their solidarity with Palestine.
Jacobin.author: Daniel Finn

Jacobin.title: How a Canadian Union Finally Bested Walmart
Jacobin.summary: Walmart has long stymied attempts to unionize any part of its business. Which is why the breakthrough union victory won by 800 workers at a Mississauga, Ontario regional distribution center is worth closely examining.
Jacobin.author: Benjamin Y. Fong

Jacobin.title: Even Musk Haters Will Hate Sitting Through Musk
Jacobin.summary: Alex Gibney’s Musk throws everything at the world’s first trillionaire, from an AI avatar in a gaming chair to first-person-shooter animation. The result is a four-hour slog that exhausts even Musk haters — and preaches a defeatism that serves the Right.
Jacobin.author: Eileen Jones

Jacobin.title: Socialize All Housing
Jacobin.summary: People are right to want control over their homes and their futures. Socialized housing, not private ownership, can make that promise a reality for everyone.
Jacobin.author: Mike Beggs, Ben Burgis, Bhaskar Sunkara

Jacobin.title: Trump’s War on Palestine Comes for Fergie Chambers

Jacobin.author: Branko Marcetic

Jacobin.title: Israel Fears NAZA. Why Don’t Our Films Scare Anyone?

Jacobin.author: Alex McCarron

Jacobin.title: The Unhinged Racist Response to France’s School Protests
Jacobin.summary: Donald Trump and J. D. Vance have called France’s protests the work of Muslim and Third World invaders. Ignoring the movement’s roots in high schooler demonstrations, they are using violent episodes to paint a dark picture of racial conflict.
Jacobin.author: Marlon Ettinger

Jacobin.title: How Revolutionary, Really, Was Christianity?

Jacobin.author: Molly Judd

Jacobin.title: The Political Economy of Cognitive Dissonance
Jacobin.summary: Cognitive dissonance helps explain why people often turn away from problems they feel powerless to change: denial takes hold. That denial can weaken the solidarity required to change the conditions that leave people feeling powerless.
Jacobin.author: Peter Dorman

Jacobin.title: Jacobin Is International

Jacobin.author: Asher Dupuy-Spencer

Jacobin.title: The Video Game Industry’s Crisis Is a Crisis of Capitalism

Jacobin.author: Alexandre Paquet

Jacobin.title: Anwar Shaikh Changed My Life

Jacobin.author: E. Ahmet Tonak

Jacobin.title: Tax the Rich and Slash the Military Budget
Jacobin.summary: The Left is often asked how it proposes to pay for programs like universal childcare, Medicare or All, and a green jobs program. Here’s how: tax wealth and capital the same way we already tax wages, and slash our bloated and destructive military budget.
Jacobin.author: Nancy Folbre
